'''Vicki Luthy''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Gold 84 from Riverside, Mo. The slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" /> In July 2003 [[Guy Kargl]] named her as the tournament director of two events of the Vintage Stock Tour, a series of sealed-deck tournaments at Vintage Stock stores in Oklahoma, Arkansas, Kansas and Missouri.<ref name="pcf-1895-30304">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=30304#30304 Vintage Stock Tour! Uncut Sheet Prizes! 7 tournaments!], Guy Kargl, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (4 July 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041101152255/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=30301 Internet Archive]</ref> She ran its Star Wars CCG event in Kansas City on 2 August 2003, where eight players drafted and built sealed decks; she played the Light Side, then dropped out so that no player would have a bye.<ref name="pcf-1895-31138">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=31138#31138 Vintage Stock Tour! Uncut Sheet Prizes! 7 tournaments!], Guy Kargl, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (30 July 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041101152255/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=30301 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-1855-32057">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=32057#32057 Vintage Stock Tour!], Guy Kargl, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (28 August 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040707042014/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=31994%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
